test_vector_casting: test the pybind11 std::vector to Python list bidirectional casting with cast_vector and load_vector
test_map_casting: test the pybind11 std::map to Python dict bidirectional casting with cast_map and load_map
test_recursive_casting: test that pybind11 STL casters preserve lvalue and rvalue context for nested containers
test_optional_casting: test the pybind11 std::optional conversion to Python None and back with double_or_zero
test_variant_casting: test the pybind11 std::variant conversion to Python Union types with load_variant and cast_variant
